title: Inspect repository and locate both source vaults
acceptance_criteria: Both source vault locations are identified or explicitly reported missing
Git state and repository structure are recorded
forbidden_side_effects: Do not rewrite or move source vault files

title: Inventory source files and assets read-only
acceptance_criteria: Every discovered file and asset has an inventory record

title: Implement persistent registry, checkpoints, and task validation
acceptance_criteria: Task state persists across fresh sessions

title: Build omission-detection pilot and verify the auditor
acceptance_criteria: Injected unique-detail, equation, caveat, link, and style defects are detected or limitations explicitly documented
Findings link to stable source-unit IDs
Pilot does not modify original vaults
